title: A field is a regular ring
statement: Let $k$ be a field. Then $k$ is a regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]: $k$ is Noetherian, its only prime ideal is $(0)$, and the localization $k_{(0)}\cong k$ is a regular local ring (of dimension $0$, its maximal ideal $(0)$ being generated by $0$ elements).
